# Design notes and attribution

`alegra-case-partner` is a custom ChatGPT skill created for the user's Alegra business analytics case workflow.

Its methodology combines common strategy-consulting practices (MECE decomposition, hypothesis-driven analysis, 80/20 prioritization, pyramid synthesis, and situation-complication-resolution) with ideas inspired by:

- `wudpeker/consulting-problem-solving` (MIT License)
- `chefjefff/mckinsey-problem-solving` (MIT License)
- Charles Conn & Robert McLean, *Bulletproof Problem Solving*

It is not affiliated with Alegra, McKinsey & Company, or the authors/source repositories.
